partnershipPlan: A family partner from the ICU family advisory group reviews the explanation given to families; two bedside nurses and one respiratory therapist sit on the A3 team.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments from the unit's family feedback cards are read for mentions of patients being woken.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If he pulls his tube out on my watch it is my name on the incident form, protocol or not.
items.implication: Show unit-level self-extubation data and make the decision a unit rule, not a personal gamble.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The screen is done by seven; then I wait for someone to say yes, and by then it is rounds.
items.implication: Test removal of the informal approval step for patients who pass the screen.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Nobody told us they would stop the sedation; we thought he was getting worse.
items.implication: Explain morning awakening to families, with an interpreter when needed.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: By the time I hear the patient passed, the sedation is back on.
items.implication: Test a shared 08:00 time and a hand-off card with respiratory therapy.

summary: Four composite voices on personal risk, waits, family understanding and coordination.
